title: Validate slot store generation before writing first-boot floor
description: P3 (wave-3 review of worker6-eni9): rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs recover_or_provision_slot_replay (~:1208-1211) writes floor=1 BEFORE loading/gating the store in the store-exists/floor-missing/stage<SLOT branch. On rejection the downgrade persists on disk; an operator 'unsticking' the boot wedge by deleting the manifest then takes the all-artifacts path that skips the gate and loads the noninitial store against floor 1 (anti-rollback anchor reset). Requires same-UID tampering + operator action, so P3. Fix: load and validate the store generation in memory first; only anchor the floor after the gate passes.
